","createdAt":"2026-09-15T11:49:08Z","url":"https://github.com/Chengyue-Lu/research-agent-workbench/pull/81#issuecomment-5679669377"},{"author":"Chengyue-Lu","body":"Technical verdict: REQUEST CHANGES，针对 exact HEAD `a60784d76d1f858296906c69b5a5f735757e6209`。当前 base 仍是 `develop@0bebafd81f0116a8269c63ac97378038a1eb2a5d`，PR mergeable，exact-head CI / governance 已通过；以下是实现语义 blocker，不是 integration blocker。

[P1] use-boundary Skill fact 目前把“调用前绑定”当成了 post-call actual binding。`record_skill_execution_use()` 在 Provider/Tool 调用前写入 `actual-skill-execution-binding`，其中已经包含 Provider/Adapter/Model/Runtime/Host 的 `actual_binding`；随后 closeout 又要求这一 pre-use fact 与 Host post-call `actual_binding` 完全一致。现有 failed-model synthetic case 为了证明 model drift，实际上在 provider-request 之前就把 `observed-drift-model` 写进所谓 actual fact。这不能独立证明“调用后实际观察到的 binding drift”，而 PR76 acceptance 明确要求 post-call-failed 的真实 drift 由独立 Trace fact 佐证。建议拆成两类事实：调用前只记录 exact consumed Projection/Supply/component bytes；调用后再记录 actual Provider/Adapter/Model/Runtime/Host/Supply binding。可复用 M11-004 的 post-call `actual-execution-binding`，或增加一个窄的 versioned Skill post-call fact。completed/failed Receipt 应同时要求 pre-use consumption fact + post-call binding fact；completed 再要求 actual == selected View，failed 允许事实佐证的 drift。`_validate_trace_execution_records()` 需要相应支持两阶段事实，而不是继续要求 post-call 只有一个 use-boundary actual fact。

[P1] `skill-execution@1.0.0` 对 wrong-kind Supply 的不兼容发现得太晚。`execute_frozen_view()` 当前在调用 Driver 前只校验 binding / selected supply ref / freshness / Runtime Bundle；Skill contract 是否真的绑定了合法 projection-backed Skill，是 Driver 返回后才通过 `validate_skill_consumption()` / `selected_skill_consumption()` 检查。因此 direct-tool / procedure View 配上 Skill closeout contract 时，Provider/Tool 可能已经真实执行，之后才失败。请在 Driver 调用前增加只读 preflight assertion：当前 frozen selected Supply 必须是 Skill，exact Projection ref 存在且 Projection↔Supply facts valid；这一步只验证已经选择的 frozen closure，不扫描候选、不选择 Supply。失败必须 `preflight-blocked`，Provider/Tool invocation=0，且无 actual binding / consumption fact。至少补 direct-tool + Skill contract、procedure/no-Skill + Skill contract、invalid Projection closure 三个 before-call negative tests。

[P2] replay 目前只证明“曾在 fact creation 前读过正确的 Supply/Projection 字节”，没有拒绝随后同一路径出现不同 hash 的第二次 read。`reads.setdefault((path, hash), position)` 会忽略后续矛盾读取；如果文件之后恢复为原 hash，replay 可能仍接受。建议至少要求 bound Supply/Projection 在 fact creation 后到 invocation 期间不得出现同一路径不同 hash 的 `content-read`；更简单可以直接要求该 contract 内各自只有一次有效读取。补一个 later-reread / different-hash negative test。

其余主体设计目前通过：4 个 Skill execution 对象是独立版本，没有原位扩义 Core/legacy Schema；Core 仍拒绝 Skill contract；Receipt 能从自身 exact refs 重载 Bundle/View/Host/Trace/Artifact/Validation 并 deterministic rebuild；completed/failed/blocked completion ceiling 正确，driver exception / incomplete capture 不具 Receipt eligibility；Resolver 仍是唯一 Supply selector，Runtime 未获得 candidate/Evaluation/oracle/admission/promotion/fallback/reselection authority；Gate B 仍 UNSATISFIED，M5-007 仍 BLOCKED。

两个 P1 都属于事实时间语义与 fail-closed preflight，不要求重做 M11-007 架构。修复后可做 focused re-review。","createdAt":"2026-09-15T13:23:36Z","url":"https://github.com/Chengyue-Lu/research-agent-workbench/pull/81#issuecomment-5680907209"}],"headRefName":"feature/m11-007-skill-closeout","headRefOid":"a60784d76d1f858296906c69b5a5f735757e6209","reviews":[{"author":"copilot-pull-request-reviewer","body":"Copilot was unable to review this pull request because the user who requested the review has reached their quota limit.","commit":"49bf25de8cd6747cc30535793a6a8d7b56b7deab","state":"COMMENTED","submittedAt":"2026-09-15T11:24:34Z"}],"state":"OPEN","title":"feat(M11-007): replay versioned Skill execution closeout from actual facts"}
